create_dataset_from_npz_directory: create a Dataset instance that scans a directory for NPZ motion files and builds a file pool
load_motion_by_index: load a Motion object from an NPZ file at a given index using Dataset.LoadMotion
filter_dataset_by_id: filter the Dataset file pool to only include files whose name contains a given ID string
get_motion_index_by_name: get the index of a motion in the Dataset by looking up its name via GetMotionIndex
get_dataset_length: get the number of filtered files in the Dataset using the len builtin on the Dataset instance
